entry.title: New: Resolution 635 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH DIAGNOSTIC LABS SERVICES INC. FOR BLOOD COLLECTION LABORATORY SERVICES

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year agreement with an estimated cost of $500 per year, to provide blood collection laboratory services for the Hawaiʻi Fire Department to be in compliance with its Bloodborne Pathogens/Infectious Disease Exposure Guidelines.
